'''Noota Ropal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He traded gold certificates for prizes at the [[Star Cluster Casino]] during [[Soovada]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />
